asked.item: Is there a 100 MB Google Drive limit?
Will a 350 MB file fit on Creator?
Virus scan warning page instead of the file

verdict.reason: The sentences say there is no 100 MB Drive cutoff, give the Creator upload limit, and give the direct URL fix and the fallback options.

steps.text: That isn't true: Blotato does not impose a 100 MB Google Drive cutoff.
The file still must fit your Blotato plan's upload limit and the destination platform's media limit, and the Creator plan's max media upload size is 1 GB.
For Google Drive files, including large videos, replace the standard share link with this format: https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id={FILE_ID}&export=download&confirm=t
Make sure the file is shared with "Anyone with the link" as Viewer.
If the direct download URL still returns the warning page, use the Presigned Upload flow, frame.io, AWS S3, or Google Cloud Storage.
